blind.description: A stylized fantasy blacksmith set featuring a dark metal anvil with an integrated stepped base and a glowing red diamond emblem in its recessed front, topped with a heavy two-handed forge hammer resting diagonally across its face. The hammer has a thick faceted rectangular head, a brown wrapped handle, and a faceted metal pommel. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and game-ready with clean painted edge highlights and subtle warm red accents in the crevices.
blind.from_above: Seen from directly above, the model displays the tapered horn of the anvil pointing left, the wide anvil body beneath, and the forge hammer laid across it horizontally with its blocky head on the left and handle extending past the right edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2 feet tall) and about 2 to 2.5 feet wide across the hammer and horn.
